rationale: Excluded as wrong topic (E01). This ethnographic article examines strategic far-right voting, disenchantment with the Labour Party, and perceptions of political fairness among residents in Higher Blackley, North Manchester, England. It does not address water or sanitation service access (C1 = no) or any water/sanitation access outcome (C4 = no).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings yield exclude because the study is an ethnography of electoral politics and national/class identity in England with no connection to water or sanitation services.

evidence_quotes.quote: Anxieties of Englishness and participation in democracy
Exploring how voting for the far right is used strategically in an attempt to communicate political disenchantment with the Labour Party
